dedup.nearest_existing: Existing anchor-distribution/cluster-estimand and versioned seed/hash-sampling contracts; neither new feature AST nor novel sampling method. HYP-014 metaranker rejection is unrelated and not repurposed.

four_fields.mechanism: Predeclared proportional stratified seeded-hash sampling of an origin-eligible user roster, strata from strictly pre-origin active dates; include all subsequent eligible mature queries for selected users and use design weights.
four_fields.prediction: May reduce variance if origin activity explains paired positive-query-macro residual; proportional allocation does not systematically enrich positives and can worsen ratio precision.
four_fields.nearest_finite_experiment: UNRUN invented 8-user,2-stratum,≤4-query/user,≤256-subset design enumeration comparing equal-cost proportional and global hash allocations; complete weighted totals, ratio errors and undefined outcomes.
four_fields.task1_benefit: Determine whether one cheap label-blind design could improve future frozen feature-comparison precision without another fit/search look.

design_contract.population: Users eligible by existing48h rule at fixed future originτ only; later entrants outside estimand, explicitly reported.
design_contract.strata: Exactly one or two active UTC dates in [τ−48h,τ), from fully covered declared log; not exposure and not future labels.
design_contract.sampling: Integer proportional quotas; each nonempty stratum has n_s>0 and n_s≤N_s; precommitted randomized seeded hash rank/tie rules; independent strata; no alternate seed search.
design_contract.queries: All selected users’ eligible queries at predeclared daily anchors; retain zero-Y queries and whole-mature24h horizons; existing purchase target and fixed C construction.
design_contract.weights: User inclusion probability π_u=n_s/N_s; w_u=N_s/n_s; A_u=sum positive-query paired NDCG differences, D_u=number of positive queries; ratio of weighted totals.
design_contract.estimand: Positive-query-macro paired difference on the origin roster, not mean user means; user clustering for inference does not redefine averaging.
design_contract.unbiasedness: Weighted A and D totals are design-unbiased; their ratio is generally finite-sample biased. Undefined denominator samples remain visible as failures.
design_contract.inference: Must reflect stratified without-replacement user design and repeated queries; exact population inference recipe not implementation/admission.
design_contract.frozen_models_final: No retuning current models or reuse of revealed final as independent holdout; new month/source only conditional future proposal.

strongest_control: Same origin roster and sample size, same model/target/C/anchors/complete cost, single precommitted global random-hash user sample; no weak query-positive or alternate-seed comparator.
strongest_counterexample: Rare positive signal concentrated in one user, within-stratum residual heterogeneity, unequal follow-up costs or later-entrant drift can make proportional strata equal/worse or non-generalizable; purchase propensity correlation alone insufficient.
cheapest_falsifier: UNRUN enumerate toy inclusion distributions; reject wrong weighted-total expectations, clock/cluster averaging errors or hidden undefined samples; defer if precision/failure rate no better at complete matched cost.

all_future_paid: source acquisition/auth/clock validation if separately allowed
fullY and maturity checks only under future authorization
